encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἐστίν. βάδιζ’ ἐπὶ δεῖπνον εἰς τὰ φειδίτια,
ἀπόλαυε τοῦ ζωμοῦ, φόρει τοὺς βύστακας
μὴ καταφρόνει, μηδ’ ἕτερ’ ἐπιζήτει καλά,
ἐν τοῖς δ’ ἐκείνων ἔθεσιν ἴσθ’ ἀρχαιικός.

div.note: Athenaeus 4, 142. 3 διακωμῳδῶν Ἀντιφάνης τὰ Λακωνικὰ δεῖπνα ἐν τῷ ἐπιγραφομένῳ δράματι Ἄρχων φησὶν οὕτως κτλ. 2. post γέγονας non interpungit A. 3. φειδίτια Α] φιλίτια Toup. Emend. III 79. φιδίτια Cobet. N. 1. 728, cuius adnotatio dignissima est quae legatur. 4. ἀπόλαυε] ἀπόλαπτε Herwerd. Mnem. nov. VI 63. φόρει τοὺς] ῥόφει, τοὺς Ruhnk. Wyttenb. Plut. VII 334, conl. Arist. Eq. 51. 5. μὴ καταφρόνει] μηκέτι φόρει Herwerd. Obs. crit. 46. 6. ἀρχαιικός Κ.] ἀρχαϊκός. cf. quae adnotavimus ad Arist. Nub. 821. Lob. Phryn. 39 sq. Aesch. Ag. 172. 6. Mnesim. 8, 4.

barbam Lacedaemonios aluisse, labia superiora totondisse multis testimoniis constat. sed τοὺς βύστακας μηκέτι φόρει nimis mirum pro τὸν βύστακα. scribendum videtur μὴ καινοτόμει, ‘de labiis radendis ne quid novato’. de ceteris ipse quoque nihil novare satius duxi.
